a.lede: Game modding communities are racing to get Grand Theft Auto VI running on PC, but one big effort has been taken down by Take-Two today. Leonida, a fan project by 15-year-old "NotRexed," has vanished after a DMCA takedown notice from GTA VI publisher Take-Two. Leonida was designed to translate a leaked GTA VI Xbox build […]
a.title: GTA VI PC recompilation project shut down by Take-Two

b.lede: Despite Take-Two's effort to shut down projects to port GTA VI, multiple projects have reported progress and could now run the game at lower frame rates on PCs.
b.title: Take-Two wipes out 3,007 GTA 6 PC port repos from GitHub in massive DMCA crackdown
